scope: art and interaction design reference; not yet production sprites or a UI migration
guidingPrinciples: Character-first: a lovable living mascot is the default focal point; PC health is secondary until actionable.
Cute through silhouette, eyes, anticipation and personality, not constant particles or movement.
Pixel-perfect sprites and selectively illustrated habitats; never blur or flatten pixel edges.
Cozy but modern Windows UI; no generic SaaS hero, gradient cards, metric-card wall, or giant headline.
Comfort-first desktop presence with quiet modes, reduced motion, high contrast and no forced engagement.
Keep all monitoring local, preserve battery/CPU budget and existing state-machine priorities.

artGrammar.silhouette: Rounded but strongly distinct profiles; intentional asymmetry; no identical generic chibi template
artGrammar.outline: 1–2 authored source pixels with selective dark outline and occasional color breaks; no vector-smooth stroke on sprite
artGrammar.palette: Approximately 8–14 deliberate colors per default mascot excluding cosmetic attachments
artGrammar.lighting: Soft warm upper-left key light, cool restrained ambient shadows, single grounded contact shadow
artGrammar.grid: Whole pixel placements, nearest-neighbor scaling, no antialiasing, no subpixel sprite position
artGrammar.facialReadability: At least two discrete eye configurations and three visibly distinct mouth/brow shapes in routine animation, verified at native size
artGrammar.expressionPriority: Eyes and shape before decorative icons; no random emoji, hearts or speech bubbles for every action
artGrammar.shading: Two or three tonal masses plus selective highlight, avoid gradient fills inside sprites
artGrammar.negativeSpace: Maintain internal silhouette openings around hands, beaks, ears and wings at reduced sizes

typography.family: Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

ui.density: compact, legible native-desktop density; meaningful white space, not oversized cards
ui.shell: warm mineral/graphite chrome, gentle borders, restrained shadow, flat color blocks; no large gradients
ui.navigation: actual persistent sections, not pop-up tabs; Home, Health, Activity, Studio, Settings

windows.quickPanel: tiny animated mascot + meaningful PC health summary + one next action; native utility controls remain discoverable
windows.mainWindow: live companion scene primary; no text hero or dashboard-grid landing; Health separate
windows.studio: dressing room stage stays visible while swapping character, outfit, environment and mode
windows.onboarding: show the character alive on first step; preserve explicit privacy and system-monitoring choices
